sources.quote: External dimensions Approx. 265×39×288 mm (width × height × length) (excludes largest projection)
Input/ Output Super-Speed USB (USB 3.1 Gen1) port × 2 AUX port × 1 Networking Ethernet（10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T）×1
AV output HDMI™ out port (HDR output supported)
Product name PlayStation®4 Product code CUH-2000 series

notes: playstation.com/en-au PS4 tech-specs page, CUH-2000 series. Sony labels the third axis 'length' (width × height × length); it is recorded as depth, the front-to-back axis of a console standing on its feet. Excludes the largest projection.

ports = the page's Input/Output, Networking and AV output rows; this model's AV output row has HDMI only (no optical out). Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. The AUX port has no §3 kind. Power row 'AC 100-240V' (internal supply); inlet not named, no power_in item.
released: the page gives no date; null. media uncovered. external_ids: Wikidata Q89813866 ('PlayStation 4 Slim').
